name: list_classes
description: List classes with pagination, package filtering, and search.

name: get_class_source
description: Get the decompiled source code of a specific class.

name: search_code
description: Search for a keyword in decompiled code. Supports search_in (class/method/field/code/comment) and package filtering.

name: get_method_code
description: Get the decompiled code of a specific method. Use get_methods_of_class first to discover available methods.

name: get_methods_of_class
description: List all methods of a class with access flags, return types, and parameters.

name: get_fields_of_class
description: List all fields of a class with access flags and types.

name: get_smali_of_class
description: Get the smali representation of a specific class.

name: get_resource_file
description: Get the content of a resource file (e.g. res/layout/activity_main.xml). Use get_all_resource_file_names to discover available files.

name: get_all_resource_file_names
description: List all resource file paths in the APK (drawables, layouts, etc.). Supports pagination.

name: get_strings
description: Get the content of res/values/strings.xml. Supports pagination for large string resources.

name: get_manifest
description: Get the AndroidManifest.xml content to inspect activities and components.

name: get_main_activity_class
description: Get the main activity class (entry point) as defined in AndroidManifest.xml. Returns class name and source code.

name: get_main_application_classes
description: Get all classes belonging to the main application package (excludes libraries). Determines the package from Manifest. Supports pagination.

name: get_package_tree
description: Show package structure with class counts, sorted by size. Marks likely library packages. Helps navigate large APKs.

name: get_method_by_name
description: Get a method's code by class name and method name. Combines class lookup and method lookup in one call.

name: search_method_by_name
description: Search for a method name across all classes. Returns all classes containing a method matching the name.

name: get_manifest_component
description: Extract specific component data (activity, provider, service, receiver) from AndroidManifest.xml. Supports filtering by exported status. Useful for security analysis.

name: get_info
description: Get decompiler information.

name: get_xrefs_to_class
description: Find all references to a class (callers, field types, method parameters, etc.). Returns a list of referencing classes and the methods where the class is used.

name: get_xrefs_to_method
description: Find all call-sites of a method. Shows where a method is invoked including override chain analysis.

name: get_xrefs_to_field
description: Find all places where a field is read or written.
